description: Read one Ashby posting in full: its locations, its description and the pay ranges its company published. Ashby addresses a posting by board and identifier, both of which search_jobs returns.

board.description: A company name, or an Ashby board token.

description.description: The description runs to thousands of characters. html is the company's own markup, unrewritten.

job_id.description: The identifier search_jobs returned for this posting.

name: get_job

currency.description: Null on a percentage of equity, which has no currency. Never converted.

interval.description: The period the amounts belong to, as Ashby writes it: 1 YEAR, 1 MONTH, 1 HOUR, NONE. Never annualised.

min.description: Null when the company promises the component without naming an amount.

summary.description: The line the company wrote for this component.

type.description: Salary, EquityCashValue, EquityPercentage, Commission, Bonus, or a value beyond them.

title.description: Names a zone or a level, and is null on most tiers.

compensation.description: Null when the caller asked for no compensation, which states nothing about the company.

compensation_summary.description: Null when the company withholds its pay ranges, which is never zero.

description.description: Null when the caller asked for no description.

is_listed.description: False marks a posting Ashby serves by direct link alone rather than on the board.

country.description: As the board publishes it, European Union included. No country code, and never corrected: one board writes USA where another writes United States.

label.description: The location as the company wrote it, free text with no taxonomy.

published_at.description: ISO 8601 with the offset Ashby publishes.

country.description: As the board publishes it, European Union included. No country code, and never corrected: one board writes USA where another writes United States.

label.description: The location as the company wrote it, free text with no taxonomy.

workplace_type.description: Null when the company records none, which is never the same as on site.

title: Read one posting
